items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Buster Cooper lived, my old road buddy.

ctx.x: And the same trombone players including Buster Cooper, he lives in town here, he lives in St. Pete. And Chuck Conners and Lawrence Brown. And Cootie and Cat Anderson and sometimes he had Ray Nance and he had Money Johnson sometimes and he had Mercer, who was the business manager as well. There was Herbie Jones. And the weight of the band most of the time was on the drummer and myself as far as keeping time. So I just kept that time.
Right. There was no rhythm guitar.
